outreach.subject: Exploratory Call: Phone-based disease detection pilot
outreach.body:
I am writing from AgriSmart, a Malaysian startup specializing in phone-based AI leaf-disease detection. We have reviewed the corporate challenge regarding offline-ready crop disease detection pilot (DEMO-CH-001) and believe our mobile workflow capabilities align with your requirements.

We are interested in exploring whether our technology could address your need for affordable disease screening at a small group of farms. Our proposed approach involves testing detection accuracy through a structured field screening process.

Would you be open to a brief exploratory call to discuss your specific requirements and how we might potentially support this pilot? 

Best regards,

AgriSmart

outreach.subject: Exploring a potential field pilot for crop disease detection
outreach.body:
I am writing from AgriSmart, a Malaysian startup specializing in phone-based AI leaf-disease detection. We have noted your interest in piloting an offline-ready crop disease detection tool through the Nusantara Food & Farms Innovation Lab challenge.

Our technology focuses on mobile workflows for crop disease detection, which aligns with your objective to pilot affordable screening tools at small farm groups. We are interested in exploring whether our capabilities could address your specific field-pilot requirements in Indonesia.

We would welcome the opportunity to schedule a brief exploratory call to learn more about your requirements and discuss how our technology might fit your needs. Please let us know if you have availability for a short conversation in the coming week.

outreach.subject: Cadangan Kerjasama Penerokaan: Pengesanan Penyakit Tanaman Melalui AI
outreach.body:
Kepada Pasukan Nusantara Food & Farms Innovation Lab,

Kami dari AgriSmart, sebuah syarikat pemula AgriTech dari Malaysia yang membangunkan teknologi pengesanan penyakit daun berasaskan AI melalui telefon pintar.

Kami telah meneliti cabaran korporat anda mengenai keperluan alat saringan penyakit tanaman yang mampu milik untuk kegunaan di ladang. Memandangkan kepakaran kami dalam pengesanan penyakit tanaman dan aliran kerja mudah alih, kami berminat untuk meneroka kemungkinan menjalankan projek rintis (pilot) bagi menangani keperluan tersebut.

Tujuan kami adalah untuk membincangkan sama ada teknologi kami sejajar dengan objektif inovasi anda di Indonesia. Kami ingin menjemput pihak tuan/puan untuk satu sesi panggilan penerokaan bagi memahami keperluan teknikal dan operasi anda dengan lebih mendalam.

Terima kasih atas masa anda. Kami menantikan maklum balas daripada pihak tuan/puan.

Salam hormat,

AgriSmart
